name: RoslynGate
description: Answers .NET symbol questions with Roslyn instead of text search: definitions, semantic references, type hierarchies, name search, and reload_workspace after structural changes. Returns compact, deterministic JSON. Built for medium and large solutions; on a couple of projects the MCP overhead can cost more than it saves. Read-only with respect to your code: it does not edit files, build, or run tests. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: All five tools are read-only and return JSON; the server does not edit files, build, or run tests.
It evaluates the solution with MSBuild, which reads project files and may run MSBuild logic from the repository. Pin the version with npx -y roslyngate@0.2.2 and only open solutions you trust.
The .cs watcher is on by default and applies edits incrementally; pass --no-watch to disable it.
If the workspace changed on disk, a call can return stale=true with empty results. Call reload_workspace and retry; that is not a missing symbol.
